transport: Gmail SMTP submission on port 587 with certificate-verified STARTTLS; IMAP over TLS read-only exact Message-ID inbox search
scope: One explicitly owner-authorized message from the private dedicated sender to itself, checked from the Docker application network. This is a transport smoke test using the same standard-library SMTP/TLS mechanism as the application; the application outbox, Internet signup/recovery links and public deployment are not accepted by this test.
limitations: Sender credentials remain in ignored operator configuration and are not active production configuration.
Same-account inbox receipt does not prove delivery to other email providers.
Public HTTPS-origin signup and password recovery require separate deployed acceptance.
